violation_type.title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3801(5))
violation_type.short_title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children
violation_type.typical_finding: The first aid kit was stored below the diaper changing table which in a location accessible to children in care.    This was corrected at inspection when the first aid kit was moved to an area inaccessible to children.

finding_variants.text: The first aid kit was stored below the diaper changing table which in a location accessible to children in care.    This was corrected at inspection when the first aid kit was moved to an area inaccessible to children.
First aid supplies was stored in a cabinet located in the kitchen/eating area. The cabinet was unlocked and accessible.
